title: Healing Kleftiko with Greek Lamb
description: A traditional Greek slow-cooked lamb recipe, perfect for a hangover cure. The tender lamb and aromatic herbs will help soothe your soul.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together olive oil, onion, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb shoulder to the bowl and coat it evenly with the marinade
Transfer the lamb to a large Dutch oven or a heavy oven-safe pot with a lid
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven
Braise the lamb for 3 hours or until it's tender and falls apart easily
Remove the lamb from the pot and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing
Strain the juices from the pot and discard the solids
Serve the sliced lamb with the strained juices spooned over the top
